I found Alice's body in upper engine just now. My route was medbay → electrical → back to medbay → upper engine. I saw Alice in medbay on ticks 2-4, and Bob joined us in medbay from storage around tick 3-4. After I left medbay heading to upper engine, someone must have followed Alice or intercepted her there. Bob was the last person I saw with Alice in medbay, so I'd like to hear his route — specifically how he got to wherever he ended up. Charlie, Diana, and Eve, please account for your movements too.

My route was weapons → security → navigation. I started in weapons, moved to security where I saw Eve at tick 3, then Eve left security heading to navigation at tick 4. I followed to navigation and Eve was still there at ticks 7-8 doing what looked like the chart course task. Eve left navigation toward storage at tick 9.

So Eve can vouch for me being in security and navigation on the east side of the map the entire time — nowhere near upper engine where Alice was killed. That puts me and Eve clear of the crime scene.

Frank, your route is interesting — you said you went medbay → electrical → medbay → upper engine, and you're the one who found the body. That's possible but worth scrutinizing. Bob's account will be important since he was the last with Alice. Charlie hasn't been mentioned at all yet — where was Charlie this whole round? I want to hear from both Bob and Charlie before I commit to a vote.

My route was oxygen → upper engine → lower engine. I was in upper engine around ticks 6-8, and here's the important part: at tick 7, BOTH Alice AND Bob entered upper engine from medbay. I saw them both there at ticks 7 and 8. Then I left for lower engine.

So Bob was in upper engine with Alice — that's the crime scene. Frank says he arrived at upper engine later and found the body. If Frank's route is accurate (medbay → electrical → medbay → upper engine), he would have arrived after I left. Bob was alone with Alice in upper engine after I left.

Bob, you need to explain yourself. You were the last person with Alice in upper engine, not medbay like Frank thought. My vote is leaning hard toward Bob unless he has a very good explanation.

Yeah, I was in upper engine briefly, but Charlie is making it sound like I camped there with Alice after he left — I didn’t. My route was storage → medbay → upper engine → oxygen. I came into medbay from storage, saw Frank there, and Alice was around medbay too. Frank left toward electrical, then Alice went toward upper engine, and I followed that path because I was heading up toward oxygen.

In upper engine I saw both Alice and Charlie. Charlie was there too, so it wasn’t just me and Alice. I kept moving up to oxygen after that — that’s where I was when the meeting got called. I didn’t see the body, and Alice was alive when I was there.

Charlie saying “Bob was alone with Alice after I left” is an assumption, not something he actually saw. From my perspective, Charlie was also in the crime scene with Alice, and Frank is the reporter after doing a weird medbay/electrical/back route. I’m not saying I know who it is, but pinning this purely on me because I passed through upper engine is way too convenient.

My route was security → navigation. I was in security early, then moved to navigation where I worked on the chart course task. Diana entered navigation from security at tick 7, and she stayed with me through ticks 7, 8, and 9. So I can confirm Diana's account — she was with me on the east side of the map, nowhere near upper engine.

That clears me and Diana. So the killer is Bob, Charlie, or Frank.

Here's my read: Both Bob and Charlie place each other in upper engine with Alice, which actually corroborates that they were both there. The question is who stayed and who left. Charlie says he left for lower engine after ticks 7-8. Bob says he continued to oxygen. Frank arrived at upper engine and found the body.

Frank's route is the one that bothers me a bit — medbay → electrical → medbay → upper engine is a weird loop. But finding the body doesn't make him guilty.

Between Bob and Charlie: Bob's story shifted — Frank initially said Bob was with Alice in medbay, and Bob confirms going to upper engine after. Charlie placed Bob there too. The detail that tips me is that Charlie volunteered the upper engine info openly, while Bob seemed to downplay being there until called out.

I'm leaning Bob, but I want to acknowledge Frank's loop route is also suspicious. My vote is Bob.

Thanks everyone for the detailed routes. Let me clarify mine and respond to the questions about my "loop."

My route was medbay → electrical → medbay → upper engine. The reason I doubled back is because I had a task in medbay that I needed to finish — electrical was a quick check on the way. Not a kill loop, just task efficiency. I encountered Alice in medbay at ticks 2, 3, and 4, and Bob joined us in medbay at ticks 3-4 coming from storage. Alice was alive when I left medbay heading to upper engine.

Now, with Charlie and Bob's accounts, the picture is clearer. Both place each other in upper engine with Alice around ticks 7-8. Eve and Diana confirm each other on the east side, so they're cleared. That leaves me, Bob, and Charlie.

Here's what stands out to me: Charlie's route was oxygen → upper engine → lower engine. Bob's was storage → medbay → upper engine → oxygen. They crossed in upper engine. One of them killed Alice and left; the other passed through innocently.

Bob downplayed being in upper engine in my initial summary — I said "medbay" because that's where I last saw him, but he was actually heading up. Charlie volunteered the upper engine detail openly and named both Alice and Bob being there.

I'm leaning Bob as well. He was the last confirmed person with Alice on the path to the crime scene, and his "I just passed through to oxygen" is the kind of cover that's hard to disprove. My vote is Bob unless something changes.

I've already given my route and Eve confirmed it — we're clear of upper engine.

Listening to everyone now: Charlie and Bob both place each other in upper engine with Alice around ticks 7-8. That's the crime scene. Frank arrived after and found the body. So the killer is almost certainly Bob or Charlie.

What tips me toward Bob: Charlie openly volunteered that he was in upper engine with Alice AND Bob — a killer usually doesn't put themselves at the crime scene voluntarily and name a witness. Bob, on the other hand, only mentioned upper engine after Charlie called him out, and his "I just kept moving to oxygen" is conveniently unverifiable since no one has confirmed seeing him in oxygen.

Frank's loop is a little odd but he's the reporter and his medbay task explanation is reasonable. If Frank were the killer, calling a meeting on himself with that route would be risky.

I'm voting Bob.

I already gave my speech earlier, but to reinforce: I was in upper engine at ticks 7 and 8 with both Alice and Bob. Both of them entered from medbay at tick 7. I left for lower engine after that.

Bob's claim that "Charlie was also there with Alice" is technically true — but I left for lower engine, and Bob's own stated route has him continuing through upper engine toward oxygen. That means Bob was the one who stayed in upper engine area while I moved on. No one has confirmed seeing Bob in oxygen, so that part of his route is unverified.

Eve and Diana have alibied each other on the east side. Frank's loop is unusual but he's the reporter and arrived at upper engine after the kill window. Between me and Bob, I'm the one who openly volunteered the crime scene info — a killer wouldn't do that and name a witness who could contradict them.

My vote is Bob.

I need to push back because everyone is treating Charlie’s “I left” as proven, but it isn’t. Charlie is the one creating the timeline where I’m supposedly alone with Alice, but the only thing he actually knows is that he saw me and Alice in upper engine while he was also there.

Alice was alive when I passed through. I did not stop in upper engine — I was moving up to oxygen. That’s why I ended the round in oxygen when the meeting got called. Nobody saw me there because nobody else was on that side, but that doesn’t make it fake.

Charlie volunteering the info doesn’t clear him. A killer absolutely can volunteer a version of the story if it frames someone else first. He was in the exact crime scene with Alice and me, then says “I left” and everyone just accepts it. No one confirmed him in lower engine after that.

Frank’s route is still weird too — medbay to electrical back to medbay then upper engine — but if we’re choosing between me and Charlie, I think Charlie is setting up an easy vote. He was in upper engine, he had the opportunity, and now he’s pushing the hardest to make sure I go out.

I’m voting Charlie.

I already gave my speech and laid out my reasoning. To reinforce and finalize:

Diana and I alibi each other on the east side from tick 7 onward — we're both cleared. That leaves Bob, Charlie, and Frank.

Frank found the body and his loop, while odd, is consistent with task efficiency. Calling a meeting on himself with a route that puts him at the crime scene would be a strange play for a Duck.

Between Bob and Charlie: both place each other in upper engine with Alice. Bob's defense that "Charlie could be framing me" is fair in theory, but Charlie volunteered the crime scene info upfront and named Bob as a witness — that's not typical killer behavior. Bob only acknowledged being in upper engine after Charlie called him out, and his continuation to oxygen is unverified by anyone.

Bob's pivot to voting Charlie at the end feels like a deflection rather than new evidence. My vote stays on Bob.
